title: Siga ta Kymata
statementMd:
You are given a permutation$^{\text{∗}}$ $p$ of every integer from $1$ to $n$. You also own a binary$^{\text{†}}$ string $s$ of size $n$ where $s_i = \mathtt{0}$ for all $1 \le i \le n$. You may do the following operation at most $5$ times:

- Choose any two integers $l$ and $r$ such that $1 \le l \le r \le n$. Then, for every $i$ such that $l \lt i \lt r$ and $\min(p_l, p_r) \lt p_i \lt \max(p_l, p_r)$ hold at the same time, you will set $s_i$ to $\mathtt{1}$.

You are also given a binary string $x$ of size $n$. After performing operations, it must hold for every $1 \le i \le n$ that if $x_i = \mathtt{1}$, then $s_i = \mathtt{1}$. Note that if $x_i = \mathtt{0}$, then $s_i$ can have **any** value.

Figure out any sequence of **at most $5$** operations such that the aforementioned condition is satisfied, or report that it is impossible to do so. Note that you **do not** have to minimize the number of operations you make.

$^{\text{∗}}$A permutation $p$ of every integer from $1$ to $n$ is a sequence of elements from $1$ to $n$ such that every element appears exactly once.$^{\text{†}}$A string $b$ of size $m$ is considered binary if and only if $b_i = \mathtt{0}$ or $b_i = \mathtt{1}$ for all $1 \le i \le m$.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($3 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains exactly $n$ integers $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ ($1 \le p_i \le n$, the elements of $p$ are pairwise distinct) — where $p_i$ is the $i$-th element of the permutation.

The third line contains a single binary string $x$ of size $n$.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, if it is impossible to perform operations such that the constraint is satisfied, output $-1$.

Otherwise, output an integer $0 \le k \le 5$, the number of operations. On the $i$-th of the next $k$ lines, output two integers $1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$, the bounds of the $i$-th operation that is performed. If there are multiple correct solutions, output any of them.

## Note

In the first example, $p = [1, 2, 3]$, and $x = \mathtt{010}$. We can perform a single operation, with $l = 1$ and $r = 3$. After the operation, we set $s_2$ to $\mathtt{1}$ since $l \lt 2 \lt r$ and $\min(p_l, p_r) \lt p_2 = 2 \lt \max(p_l, p_r)$ hold at the same time. As a result, $s = \mathtt{010}$.

In the second example, it can be shown that there does not exist a correct sequence of at most $5$ operations, so we output $-1$.

In the third example, $p = [1, 3, 2, 4, 6, 5]$ and $x = \mathtt{001100}$. After performing an operation for $l = 1$ and $r = 5$, then $s = \mathtt{011100}$. If we also perform an operation for $l = 2$ and $r = 6$, then $s$ will remain the same. The string $s = \mathtt{011100}$ is valid, because for every position where $x$ has a $\mathtt{1}$, then $s$ also has a $\mathtt{1}$ at that position.
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的所有整数构成的排列$^{\text{∗}}$ $p$。你还有一个长度为 $n$ 的 01 串$^{\text{†}}$ $s$，初始时对所有 $1 \le i \le n$ 都有 $s_i = \mathtt{0}$。你可以执行以下操作至多 $5$ 次：

- 选择任意两个整数 $l$ 和 $r$，满足 $1 \le l \le r \le n$。然后，对于所有同时满足 $l \lt i \lt r$ 与 $\min(p_l, p_r) \lt p_i \lt \max(p_l, p_r)$ 的 $i$，都将 $s_i$ 设为 $\mathtt{1}$。

再给定一个长度为 $n$ 的 01 串 $x$。在执行完操作后，必须对所有 $1 \le i \le n$ 满足：若 $x_i = \mathtt{1}$，则 $s_i = \mathtt{1}$。注意，若 $x_i = \mathtt{0}$，则 $s_i$ 可以取**任意**值。

找出任意一个满足上述条件的**至多 $5$** 次操作的序列，或者报告这样做是不可能的。注意，你**不必**最小化所执行操作的次数。

$^{\text{∗}}$由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的所有整数构成的排列 $p$ 是一个由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的元素组成的序列，且每个元素恰好出现一次。$^{\text{†}}$一个长度为 $m$ 的字符串 $b$ 被视为 01 串，当且仅当对所有 $1 \le i \le m$ 都有 $b_i = \mathtt{0}$ 或 $b_i = \mathtt{1}$。

## 输入格式

每个测试点包含多组测试数据。第一行包含测试数据的组数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。下面是各组测试数据的描述。

每组测试数据的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$3 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$）— 表示数组的大小。

第二行包含恰好 $n$ 个整数 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$（$1 \le p_i \le n$，$p$ 的元素两两不同）— 其中 $p_i$ 是排列的第 $i$ 个元素。

第三行包含一个长度为 $n$ 的 01 串 $x$。

保证所有测试数据的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试数据，如果无法通过执行操作满足约束条件，输出 $-1$。

否则，输出一个整数 $0 \le k \le 5$，表示操作的次数。在接下来的 $k$ 行中，第 $i$ 行输出两个整数 $1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$，表示所执行的第 $i$ 次操作的边界。如果存在多组正确的解，输出任意一组即可。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，$p = [1, 2, 3]$，$x = \mathtt{010}$。我们可以只执行一次操作，取 $l = 1$ 和 $r = 3$。操作后，我们将 $s_2$ 设为 $\mathtt{1}$，因为 $l \lt 2 \lt r$ 与 $\min(p_l, p_r) \lt p_2 = 2 \lt \max(p_l, p_r)$ 同时成立。最终得到 $s = \mathtt{010}$。

在第二个样例中，可以证明不存在正确的至多 $5$ 次操作的序列，因此我们输出 $-1$。

在第三个样例中，$p = [1, 3, 2, 4, 6, 5]$，$x = \mathtt{001100}$。在执行了一次 $l = 1$、$r = 5$ 的操作之后，$s = \mathtt{011100}$。如果我们再执行一次 $l = 2$、$r = 6$ 的操作，$s$ 将保持不变。字符串 $s = \mathtt{011100}$ 是合法的，因为对于 $x$ 中每个为 $\mathtt{1}$ 的位置，$s$ 在该位置上也同为 $\mathtt{1}$。
